messages.author: Oona Oikola
messages.text:
On TRN-100 now, swapped the SFP on xe-0/1/0. Link is up, alarms clear, no traffic and counters at zero.
Going to try the disable and enable from the TRN-042 case.

messages.author: Oona Oikola
messages.text: Disabled and enabled at 13:25. Counters are still at zero, it did not help.

messages.author: Erkki Expert
messages.text: TRN-100 is one of the new 6.x boxes. What I said about the old units was about the 4.x firmware ones. I would not expect it to help there.

messages.author: Pekka Päivystäjä
messages.text: Look at the service profile on that port. The migration last month may have dropped something.

messages.author: Oona Oikola
messages.text: VLAN 412 was missing from the profile on xe-0/1/0. Added it.

messages.author: Oona Oikola
messages.text: Traffic is back. So it was the VLAN, not the bounce.
